verses.arabicText: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Qaf wal-qur'āni l-majīd
verses.translation: Qãf. By the glorious Quran

verses.arabicText: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verses.transliteration: Bal ʿajibū an jāahum mundhirum-min'hum faqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā shayon ʿajīb
verses.translation: ˹All will be resurrected,˺ yet the deniers are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves ˹warning of resurrection˺. So the disbelievers say, “This is an astonishing thing

verses.arabicText: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: A-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban dhālika rajʿun baʿīd
verses.translation: ˹Will we be returned to life,˺ when we are dead and reduced to dust? Such a return is impossible.”

verses.arabicText: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
verses.transliteration: Qad ʿalim'nā mā tanquṣu l-arḍu min'hum waʿindanā kitābun ḥafīẓ
verses.translation: We certainly know what the earth consumes of them ˹after their death˺, and with us is a well-preserved Record

verses.arabicText: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
verses.transliteration: Bal kadhabū bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahum fahum fī amrim-marīj
verses.translation: In fact, they reject the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state

verses.arabicText: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ
verses.transliteration: Afalam yanẓurū ilā s-samāi fawqahum kayfa banaynāhā wazayyannāhā wamā lahā min furūj
verses.translation: Have they not then looked at the sky above them: how We built it and adorned it ˹with stars˺, leaving it flawless

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
verses.transliteration: Wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin bahīj
verses.translation: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and produced in it every type of pleasant plant—

verses.arabicText: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.transliteration: Tabṣirataw-wadhik'rā likulli ʿabdim-munīb
verses.translation: ˹all as˺ an insight and a reminder to every servant who turns ˹to Allah˺

verses.arabicText: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَـٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wanazzalnā mina s-samāi māam-mubārakan fa-anbatnā bihi jannātiw-waḥabba l-ḥaṣīd
verses.translation: And We send down blessed rain from the sky, bringing forth gardens and grains for harvest

verses.arabicText: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Wal-nakhla bāsiqātil-lahā ṭalʿun-naḍīd
verses.translation: and towering palm trees ˹loaded˺ with clustered fruit

verses.arabicText: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
verses.transliteration: Riz'qal-lil'ʿibādi wa-aḥyaynā bihi baldatam-maytan kadhālika l-khurūj
verses.translation: ˹as˺ a provision for ˹Our˺ servants. And with this ˹rain˺ We revive a lifeless land. Similar is the emergence ˹from the graves˺

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
verses.transliteration: Kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥiw-wa-aṣḥābu r-rasi wathamūd
verses.translation: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth,˺ as did the people of the Water-pit, Thamûd

verses.arabicText: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
verses.transliteration: Waʿāduw-wafir'ʿawnu wa-ikh'wānu lūṭ
verses.translation: ’Ȃd, Pharaoh, the kinfolk of Lot

verses.arabicText: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-aṣḥābu l-aykati waqawmu tubbaʿin kullun kadhaba r-rusula faḥaqqa waʿīd
verses.translation: the residents of the Forest, and the people of Tubba’. Each rejected ˹their˺ messenger, so My warning was fulfilled

verses.arabicText: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verses.transliteration: Afaʿayīnā bil-khalqi l-awali bal hum fī labsim-min khalqin jadīd
verses.translation: Were We incapable of creating ˹them˺ the first time? In fact, they are in doubt about ˹their˺ re-creation

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna wanaʿlamu mā tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi min ḥabli l-warīd
verses.translation: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ created humankind and ˹fully˺ know what their souls whisper to them, and We are closer to them than ˹their˺ jugular vein

verses.arabicText: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Idh yatalaqqā l-mutalaqiyāni ʿani l-yamīni waʿani sh-shimāli qaʿīd
verses.translation: As the two recording-angels—˹one˺ sitting to the right, and ˹the other to˺ the left—note ˹everything˺

verses.arabicText: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Mā yalfiẓu min qawlin illā ladayhi raqībun ʿatīd
verses.translation: not a word does a person utter without having a ˹vigilant˺ observer ready ˹to write it down˺

verses.arabicText: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
verses.transliteration: Wajāat sakratu l-mawti bil-ḥaqi dhālika mā kunta min'hu taḥīd
verses.translation: ˹Ultimately,˺ with the throes of death will come the truth. This is what you were trying to escape

verses.arabicText: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wanufikha fī ṣ-ṣūri dhālika yawmu l-waʿīd
verses.translation: And the Trumpet will be blown. This is the Day ˹you were˺ warned of

verses.arabicText: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Wajāat kullu nafsim-maʿahā sāiquw-washahīd
verses.translation: Each soul will come forth with an angel to drive it and another to testify

verses.arabicText: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Laqad kunta fī ghaflatim-min hādhā fakashafnā ʿanka ghiṭāaka fabaṣaruka l-yawma ḥadīd
verses.translation: ˹It will be said to the denier,˺ “You were totally heedless of this. Now We have lifted this veil of yours, so Today your sight is sharp!”

verses.arabicText: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Waqāla qarīnuhu hādhā mā ladayya ʿatīd
verses.translation: And one’s accompanying-angel will say, “Here is the record ready with me.”

verses.arabicText: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
verses.transliteration: Alqiyā fī jahannama kulla kaffārin ʿanīd
verses.translation: ˹It will be said to both angels,˺ “Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever

verses.arabicText: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
verses.transliteration: Mannāʿil-lil'khayri muʿ'tadim-murīb
verses.translation: withholder of good, transgressor, and doubter

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī jaʿala maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fa-alqiyāhu fī l-ʿadhābi sh-shadīd
verses.translation: who set up another god with Allah. So cast them into the severe punishment.”

verses.arabicText: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.transliteration: Qāla qarīnuhu rabbanā mā aṭghaytuhu walākin kāna fī ḍalālin baʿīd
verses.translation: One’s ˹devilish˺ associate will say, “Our Lord! I did not make them transgress. Rather, they were far astray ˹on their own˺.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Qāla lā takhtaṣimū ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-waʿīd
verses.translation: Allah will respond, “Do not dispute in My presence, since I had already given you a warning

verses.arabicText: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Mā yubaddalu l-qawlu ladayya wamā anā biẓallāmil-lil'ʿabīd
verses.translation: My Word cannot be changed, nor am I unjust to ˹My˺ creation.”

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
verses.transliteration: Yawma naqūlu lijahannama hali im'talati wataqūlu hal mim-mazīd
verses.translation: ˹Beware of˺ the Day We will ask Hell, “Are you full ˹yet˺?” And it will respond, “Are there any more?”

verses.arabicText: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna ghayra baʿīd
verses.translation: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far off

verses.arabicText: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā mā tūʿadūna likulli awwābin ḥafīẓ
verses.translation: ˹And it will be said to them,˺ “This is what you were promised, for whoever ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺ and kept up ˹His commandments˺—

verses.arabicText: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.transliteration: Man khashiya r-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi wajāa biqalbim-munīb
verses.translation: who were in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing ˹Him˺, and have come with a heart turning ˹only to Him˺

verses.arabicText: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
verses.transliteration: Ud'khulūhā bisalāmin dhālika yawmu l-khulūd
verses.translation: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternal life!”

verses.arabicText: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Lahum mā yashāūna fīhā waladaynā mazīd
verses.translation: There they will have whatever they desire, and with Us is ˹even˺ more

verses.arabicText: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.transliteration: Wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu min'hum baṭshan fanaqqabū fī l-bilādi hal mim-maḥīṣ
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, who were far mightier than them. Then ˹when the torment came,˺ they ˹desperately˺ sought refuge in the land. ˹But˺ was there any escape

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā liman kāna lahu qalbun aw alqā s-samʿa wahuwa shahīd
verses.translation: Surely in this is a reminder for whoever has a ˹mindful˺ heart and lends an attentive ear

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqnā s-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmiw-wamā massanā mil-lughūb
verses.translation: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, and We were not ˹even˺ touched with fatigue

verses.arabicText: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
verses.transliteration: Fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi sh-shamsi waqabla l-ghurūb
verses.translation: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset

verses.arabicText: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.transliteration: Wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-adbāra s-sujūd
verses.translation: And glorify Him during part of the night and after the prayers

verses.arabicText: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa-is'tamiʿ yawma yunādi l-munādi mim-makānin qarīb
verses.translation: And listen! On the Day the caller will call out from a near place

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yasmaʿūna ṣ-ṣayḥata bil-ḥaqi dhālika yawmu l-khurūj
verses.translation: the Day all will hear the ˹mighty˺ Blast in ˹all˺ truth, that will be the Day of emergence ˹from the graves˺

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wa-ilaynā l-maṣīr
verses.translation: It is certainly We Who give life and cause death. And to Us is the final return

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
verses.transliteration: Yawma tashaqqaqu l-arḍu ʿanhum sirāʿan dhālika ḥashrun ʿalaynā yasīr
verses.translation: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the earth will split open, letting them rush forth. That will be an easy gathering for Us

verses.arabicText: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna wamā anta ʿalayhim bijabbārin fadhakkir bil-qur'āni may-yakhāfu waʿīd
verses.translation: We know best what they say. And you ˹O Prophet˺ are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺. So remind with the Quran ˹only˺ those who fear My warning
